caption: The drawing depicts an aerial view of a landscaped area that includes several geometric buildings, winding paths, and organized garden plots. The largest structure, centrally located, has a red roof and is surrounded by paths and green lawn. Smaller red-roofed buildings are scattered throughout the composition. The top part of the image contains an ornamental garden, characterized by circular and semi-circular patterns in shades of green, yellow, and purple, with a rectangular greenhouse or building adjacent to it. The landscape features clusters of trees depicted in various shades of green, blue, and yellow, with some trees rendered in more abstract brushstrokes. Curved white pathways connect the different areas and buildings, intersecting the swaths of green grass. The drawing is bordered by a thin brown frame and has a beige background.
title: Estate of Isaac P. Martin
